items.source: Supports direct matches, for example, a registered "/test" matches "/test", and various path pattern matches, for example, a registered "/t*" pattern matches both "/test" and "/team", "/test/*" matches all paths under "/test", "/test/**" matches all paths below "/test". For details, see the PathPattern javadoc.
items.translation: 支持直接匹配，例如注册的"/test"匹配"/test"，以及各种路径模式匹配，例如注册的"/t*"模式同时匹配"/test"和"/team"，"/test/*"匹配"/test"下的所有路径，"/test/**"匹配"/test"下方的所有路径。有关详细信息，请参阅PathPattern 文档。

items.source:
Will search all path patterns to find the most specific match for the
current request path. The most specific pattern is defined as the longest
path pattern with the fewest captured variables and wildcards.
items.translation: 将搜索所有路径模式，以找到与当前请求路径最具体的匹配项。最具体的模式定义为具有最少捕获变量和通配符的最长路径模式。

items.source:
If you want to allow your controllers to be lazily initialized,
make them "lazy-init" and set this flag to true. Just making them
"lazy-init" will not work, as they are initialized through the
references from the handler mapping in this case.
items.translation: 如果您希望允许控制器进行懒加载初始化，请将它们设置为"lazy-init"并将此标志设为 true。仅将它们设置为"lazy-init"是无效的，因为在这种情况下，它们是通过处理器映射中的引用进行初始化的。

items.source:
Supports direct matches, for example, a registered "/test" matches "/test",
and various path pattern matches, for example, a registered "/t*" matches
both "/test" and "/team". For details, see the PathPattern class.
items.translation: 支持直接匹配，例如注册的"/test"匹配"/test"，以及各种路径模式匹配，例如注册的"/t*"同时匹配"/test"和"/team"。有关详细信息，请参阅 PathPattern 类。

for example to enforce specific preconditions expressed in URL mappings.
items.translation: 默认实现为空。可以在子类中重写，例如用于强制实施 URL 映射中表达的具体前置条件。

items.source: Configure a predicate for extended matching of the handler that was matched by URL path. This allows for further narrowing of the mapping by checking additional properties of the request. If the predicate returns "false", it result in a no-match, which allows another HandlerMapping to match or result in a 404 (NOT_FOUND) response.
items.translation: 配置一个谓词，用于对通过 URL 路径匹配的处理器进行扩展匹配。这允许通过检查请求的附加属性来进一步缩小映射范围。如果该谓词返回"false"，则结果为不匹配，从而允许另一个HandlerMapping进行匹配或导致 404 (NOT_FOUND) 响应。

items.source:
On CORS pre-flight requests this method should return a match not for
the pre-flight request but for the expected actual request based on the URL
path, the HTTP methods from the "Access-Control-Request-Method" header, and
the headers from the "Access-Control-Request-Headers" header.
items.translation: 在 CORS 预检请求中，此方法不应针对预检请求返回匹配结果，而应基于 URL 路径、来自"Access-Control-Request-Method"标头的 HTTP 方法以及来自"Access-Control-Request-Headers"标头的标头，针对预期的实际请求返回匹配结果。
